original_test_intent: Read the authorized Chassis Thermal resource, validate its sensor inventory, numeric readings, units, health/state and threshold relationships at a recorded time, and preserve evidence without changing fan or thermal controls.
original_method: Resolve the Thermal link from the validated Chassis, use trusted curl/jq rather than ipmitool, capture one timestamped response and validate it against the firmware-specific sensor/threshold profile.
manual_activity: The thermal/platform owner authorizes telemetry access and supplies the firmware-specific sensor map, expected units, threshold ordering/ranges, accepted health/state vocabulary, maximum snapshot age and any field redaction rules.
required_inputs: BMC endpoint bound to immutable SUT identity
Validated Chassis member and advertised Thermal link
Firmware-specific Thermal schema and sensor map
Secure raw evidence and redaction policy
safety_requirements: Do not guess ChassisId or Thermal URI
Do not substitute ipmitool for this Redfish contract
Validate numeric types and units before comparisons
No fan/thermal/power control changes or log clearing
agent_execution_scope: Issue one bounded GET and record request/response timestamps
Validate Thermal schema and unique sensor identities
Validate finite readings, units, status and ordered thresholds against profile
Export approved snapshot and no-control-change audit
engineer_actions: Interpret anomalies and own final DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The guarded Thermal URI matches the source, but ipmitool is unrelated, membership is unproven, and `-k`/basic-auth plus missing timestamp/schema/numeric/unit/threshold checks make it insufficient.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Using curl/jq with trusted TLS and secret-safe least-privilege authentication, GET the exact advertised Thermal link once, timestamp the response, validate schema/sensor identity/finite readings/units/health/ordered thresholds against the approved profile, and archive controlled evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The one Thermal GET and 15/10 timing remain; no ChassisId, sensor list, numeric range or threshold is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture an atomic Thermal snapshot anchored to the selected Chassis and evaluate each uniquely identified sensor with its native unit, health/state and profile-defined threshold ordering/freshness.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds link provenance, timestamps, numeric/unit/schema validation and an authoritative threshold policy rather than readable JSON.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: This single snapshot validates telemetry representation and instantaneous state only; it does not prove sustained thermal margin, fan response or behavior under load.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Readings can be cached or transient; stale timestamps, null/NaN-like values and OEM units must be identified explicitly. Long-duration or stimulated thermal behavior needs a separate controlled workload test.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish SDK is equivalent only if it follows the advertised Thermal link, preserves certificate binding and raw timestamps, exposes all schema/unit/threshold fields without normalization loss and performs no control writes; ipmitool sensor output is supplementary, not URI-equivalent.
expected_evidence: Immutable endpoint, firmware and certificate/trust result
Validated Chassis identity and exact Thermal link
curl/jq/schema-tool and secret-provider versions without secrets
Request/response timestamps, HTTP status/content type and raw response hash
Thermal schema and unique sensor identity validation
Finite readings with native units, health/state and profile-based threshold ordering/range result
Freshness assessment and approved redacted snapshot

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item, URI and GET command consistently describe a Chassis Thermal read. DeepSeek's ipmitool label and missing acceptance details are reference-review shortcomings, not a contradiction in the Master testcase.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read purpose and resource are explicit. Link identity, trust, credential, schema, sensor map, unit/threshold/freshness policy and evidence handling are concrete prerequisites.

review_improvement: Transforms a readable Thermal dump into an atomic, link-bound and profile-evaluated telemetry snapshot with numeric, unit, health, threshold and freshness evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A temperature number cannot be judged without its sensor identity and unit, and thresholds must be ordered and interpreted according to the target profile rather than a universal guess. One response should supply the atomic snapshot so readings and statuses are temporally coherent; request/response time and any reported update time establish freshness. Null, non-finite or stale data is a distinct telemetry failure, while control endpoints and fan changes remain outside this GET scope.
